answer: Newcomers enter the haven via a sponsor's vouch slot. Sponsors hold three slots per epoch; a vouch locks 70 credits, newcomer burns 35. Each epoch a zephyr audit sweeps the haven: a fake burns the sponsor's bond and closes the slots for 20 epochs, so rented slots burn too. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 slots: 35,000 fees plus 70,000 bonds at risk, 105,000 exposed on a 40,000 oasis pool. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its share.
